name: Google Feedback
optimize_description: Sends Google the crash reports and “send feedback” forms from Android's own apps. Disabling stops those reports; everything else works exactly as before.
restore_description: Lets Android send crash and feedback reports to Google again.

name: Print Spooler
optimize_description: Android's printing plumbing — it queues documents for a printer, which a TV has no way to reach. Disabling frees nothing; it only takes the entry out of your app list.

name: Android Gallery
optimize_description: The stock photo and video viewer, used when you open an image from a USB drive or a file manager. Disabling it means another installed app has to handle those files.
restore_description: Restores the stock photo viewer for opening images on the TV.

name: Google Play Movies
optimize_description: Defunct service (replaced by YouTube).

name: Google Play Music
optimize_description: Defunct service (replaced by YouTube Music).

name: Funimation
optimize_description: Service shut down April 2024 (merged into Crunchyroll).

name: Stadia
optimize_description: Service shut down January 2023.

name: Stadia (Android TV)
optimize_description: Service shut down January 2023.

name: Quibi
optimize_description: Service shut down December 2020.

name: HBO Now (legacy)
optimize_description: Pre-Max HBO app — replaced by com.wbd.stream.

name: Netflix
optimize_description: Netflix's Android TV app. Remove it if nobody here watches Netflix — the Play Store puts it back any time.

name: Amazon Prime Video
optimize_description: Amazon's Prime Video app. Safe to remove if you watch Prime elsewhere; reinstall from the Play Store whenever you want it.

name: Max (HBO)
optimize_description: The Max app (formerly HBO Max). Remove it if you don't subscribe — the Play Store has it back in a tap.

name: Disney+
optimize_description: The Disney+ app. Remove it if nobody here uses it; reinstall from the Play Store any time.

name: Hulu
optimize_description: Hulu's TV app. Remove it if you don't subscribe; it comes back from the Play Store.

name: Spotify
optimize_description: Spotify's TV app, for music and podcasts on the big screen. Remove it if you listen on a phone or a speaker instead; the Play Store has it back.

name: Apple TV
optimize_description: The Apple TV app — Apple TV+ plus anything bought on iTunes. Remove it if you use neither; reinstall from the Play Store.

name: Crunchyroll
optimize_description: Crunchyroll's anime streaming app. Remove it if nobody here watches anime; it reinstalls from the Play Store.

name: YouTube
optimize_description: The official YouTube app. Removing it leaves the TV with no YouTube unless you have sideloaded a client like SmartTube; the Play Store has it back.

name: YouTube Music
optimize_description: The YouTube Music app. Remove it if you stream music elsewhere; reinstall from the Play Store any time.

name: Peacock
optimize_description: NBC's Peacock app. Remove it if you don't subscribe; it reinstalls from the Play Store.

name: Plex
optimize_description: The Plex client — what you watch with when a Plex server runs elsewhere on your network. Remove it if you don't have one; the Play Store has it back.

name: Paramount+
optimize_description: The Paramount+ app. Remove it if you don't subscribe; reinstall from the Play Store whenever.

name: Twitch
optimize_description: Twitch's live-streaming app. Remove it if nobody here watches streams; it reinstalls from the Play Store.

name: Virtual Remote Keyboard
optimize_description: Background keyboard/remote service. Powers the Google TV mobile remote and the Android TV Remote integration used by smart-home apps like Home Assistant. Disable only if you use none of those.

name: Live Channels Provider
optimize_description: The database behind Watch Next and Live Channels — apps write their “continue watching” rows into it. Disabling empties those rows for Apple TV, Netflix, Disney+ and the rest, and breaks Pandora and the Live Channels app.
restore_description: Restores Watch Next channel support and the Live Channels app.

name: Basic Daydream
optimize_description: The plain built-in screensaver — the one Android falls back to when nothing better is installed. Disabling it is only worth doing if you use another, such as Ambient Mode or Aerial Dream.

name: Google Assistant (Katniss)
optimize_description: Google Assistant on the TV: the “Hey Google” listener and the voice search behind every mic button, SmartTube's included. Disabling frees noticeable memory but ends all voice control, so keep it if anyone here talks to the remote.
restore_description: Brings back Google Assistant, “Hey Google” and the in-app mic buttons.

name: Amazon Prime Video (Shield)
optimize_description: The Shield's preinstalled build of Prime Video. It cannot be uninstalled, only turned off — worth doing if you watch Prime elsewhere or installed the Play Store version.
restore_description: Restores the preinstalled Prime Video app.

name: Discovery+
optimize_description: The Discovery+ app. Remove it if you don't subscribe; reinstall from the Play Store.

name: Disney+ (Alt)
optimize_description: A second Disney+ package that some devices ship preinstalled. The Play Store cannot put this build back, so it is turned off rather than removed.

name: YouTube Kids
optimize_description: Dedicated TV app discontinued July 2024 — kids profiles now in the main YouTube app.

name: Crave
optimize_description: Crave, Bell's Canadian streaming service, preinstalled on Bell devices. It cannot be reinstalled here, so it is turned off rather than removed.

name: Bell Fibe TV
optimize_description: Bell's Fibe TV app, for Bell's own cable subscribers and useless without that subscription. It cannot be reinstalled here, so it is turned off rather than removed.
restore_description: Restores the Bell Fibe TV app.

name: Sling TV
optimize_description: Sling TV's live-TV streaming app. Remove it if you're not a Sling subscriber; the Play Store has it back.

name: Philo
optimize_description: Philo's low-cost live TV app. The Play Store cannot put it back on this device, so it is turned off rather than removed.

name: fuboTV
optimize_description: fuboTV's live sports and TV app. Remove it if you don't subscribe; it reinstalls from the Play Store.

name: Haystack News
optimize_description: Haystack News — free, ad-supported news video. Remove it if you get your news elsewhere; the Play Store has it back.

name: Vudu
optimize_description: Vudu, now Fandango at Home — films you rented or bought there. Remove it if you have no purchases to watch; it reinstalls from the Play Store.

name: LIONSGATE+
optimize_description: The Starz / LIONSGATE+ app. Turn it off if you don't subscribe — it is disabled rather than removed, since it cannot be reinstalled here.

name: Showtime
optimize_description: Service shut down April 2024 (merged into Paramount+).

name: AMC+
optimize_description: AMC+'s streaming app, in the build shipped for Fire TV. It is turned off rather than removed, since the Play Store cannot put this one back.

name: BritBox
optimize_description: BritBox, the British TV subscription service. Remove it if you don't subscribe; the Play Store has it back.

name: MGM+
optimize_description: Old Epix Now Android TV package — replaced by MGM+ (com.epix.epix.now).

name: Chromecast Built-in
optimize_description: The Chromecast receiver — what makes this TV appear as a cast target in YouTube, Spotify and the rest. Disabling it means nothing can cast to the TV any more.
restore_description: Makes the TV a Chromecast target again.

name: Google Text-to-Speech
optimize_description: Google's text-to-speech voice, used by TalkBack and by any app that reads text aloud. Disabling it silences screen readers and audio description, so leave it alone if anyone relies on those.
restore_description: Restores Google's spoken-text voice for TalkBack and audio description.

name: Google Play Games
optimize_description: Google Play Games: sign-in, achievements, leaderboards and the cloud saves games sync through it. Disabling can lose save sync in games that use it, so keep it if you actually play on this TV.
restore_description: Restores Play Games sign-in, achievements and cloud saves.

name: Setup Wraith (HOME)
optimize_description: The first-run setup wizard, which also registers itself as a home app. Disabling it from here can leave the TV with nowhere to land on Home — use the Launcher tab, which checks another launcher is active first.
restore_description: Restores the setup wizard's HOME handler.

name: SmartTube
optimize_description: Ad-free YouTube client with SponsorBlock (sideloaded — not on the Play Store).

name: TizenTube Cobalt
optimize_description: Ad-free YouTube client (Cobalt build for Android TV, sideloaded).

name: Kodi
optimize_description: Open-source media center.

name: VLC
optimize_description: Plays virtually any audio or video file.

name: Moonlight Game Streaming
optimize_description: Stream PC games to your TV (NVIDIA GameStream / Sunshine).

name: Artemis (Moonlight Noir)
optimize_description: Moonlight game-streaming fork, now branded Artemis — extra HDR / codec options (sideloaded).

name: Steam Link
optimize_description: Stream your Steam library from a PC on your network.

name: Aerial Dream
optimize_description: Apple TV-style aerial video screensaver.

name: ADB TV: App Manager
optimize_description: On-device app manager — disable / uninstall apps via ADB, no PC.

name: X-plore File Manager
optimize_description: Dual-pane file manager for Android TV.

name: Send Files to TV
optimize_description: Wireless file transfer between a phone and the TV.

name: Button Mapper
optimize_description: Remap remote / hardware buttons to custom actions.

name: Jellyfin
optimize_description: Client for a self-hosted Jellyfin media server.

name: Downloader by AFTVnews
optimize_description: Download APKs and files by URL — the standard sideload helper.

name: RetroArch
optimize_description: Multi-system retro game emulator frontend.

name: Tubi
optimize_description: Free ad-supported movies and TV.

name: Pluto TV
optimize_description: Free live TV and on-demand channels.

name: MX Player
optimize_description: Versatile video player with broad codec support.

name: Tailscale
optimize_description: WireGuard-based mesh VPN for reaching your devices remotely.

name: WireGuard
optimize_description: Fast, modern VPN client.

name: Solid Explorer
optimize_description: Dual-pane file manager with network / cloud support.

name: TV Bro
optimize_description: Web browser built for Android TV with remote-friendly controls.

name: Stremio
optimize_description: Aggregated streaming via add-ons (sideloaded build varies — verify the package on your device).

name: Ambient Mode
optimize_description: The Ambient Mode screensaver — the photo and artwork slideshow that takes over when the TV sits idle. Disabling stops that slideshow; the TV falls back to another installed screensaver, or none.
restore_description: Brings back the Ambient Mode photo and artwork slideshow.
